headline: Oil Prices Ease 1% Amid Ongoing Middle East Supply Risks
summary: Crude oil futures fell over 1% following a previous surge, as market participants evaluated persistent Middle East supply risks against broader economic concerns.
why: Crude oil is a primary benchmark for energy markets globally, directly impacting transportation costs, trade balances, and central bank inflation targets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Traders took profits following a sharp price rally driven by geopolitical tensions in production regions.

why_moved: Oil prices retreated as profit-taking occurred after a sharp rally, though ongoing supply concerns in energy-producing regions capped further losses.
